title.en: Path states include the merged convergence corrections
title.es: Las trayectorias incluyen las correcciones de convergencia
title.pt: As trajetórias incluem as correções de convergência
title.fr: Les trajectoires intègrent les corrections de convergence

explanation.en: Merged nonlinear chord arithmetic and convergence checks change path displacements and intermediate history at floating-point precision. Re-run saved arc-length and displacement-control analyses (#1952, #1940).
explanation.es: La aritmética de la cuerda y las comprobaciones de convergencia cambian desplazamientos e historia a precisión de coma flotante. Repita los análisis guardados de longitud de arco y control de desplazamiento (#1952, #1940).
explanation.pt: A aritmética da corda e as verificações de convergência alteram deslocamentos e histórico na precisão de ponto flutuante. Refaça as análises salvas de comprimento de arco e controle de deslocamento (#1952, #1940).
explanation.de: Sehnenarithmetik und Konvergenzprüfungen ändern Verschiebungen und Verlauf innerhalb der Gleitkommagenauigkeit. Gespeicherte Bogenlängen- und Verschiebungsanalysen erneut ausführen (#1952, #1940).
explanation.fr: L’arithmétique de la corde et les contrôles de convergence modifient déplacements et historique à la précision flottante. Relancer les analyses enregistrées de longueur d’arc et de contrôle en déplacement (#1952, #1940).
explanation.tr: Kiriş aritmetiği ve yakınsama denetimleri yer değiştirmeleri ve geçmişi kayan nokta hassasiyetinde değiştirir. Kaydedilmiş yay uzunluğu ve yer değiştirme kontrollü analizleri yeniden çalıştırın (#1952, #1940).

changelog.heading: Merged nonlinear convergence and physical reaction recovery (2026-11-12)
